about_the_game:
A minimalist Roguelike × Idle: click a tile to mine a resource - while your lifeline constantly drains. Food keeps you alive, materials fuel your research. Each month the drain accelerates. At the end of every year you choose 1 of 3 milestone cards and spend your Research Points in a year-end shop to reshape your run. How long can you keep the line from going flat?

Features

  • Risk–reward mining: Pick tiles to auto-harvest food and materials while HP ticks away.

  • Vital pressure: The drain speeds up after each month - time itself is the enemy.

  • Year-end milestone cards: Draw 3, keep 1. Big, run-defining effects - no monthly cards.

  • Year-end research shop: Spend Research Points + resources on powerful, run-long upgrades.

  • Clean 2D style: Fast, readable, and focused - perfect for “just one more year.”

Why BLEEDOUT?

There are no traditional enemies - your lifeline is the antagonist. Every click is a trade-off: stabilize now or invest for later? Year-end cards and the research shop create bold builds and fresh runs without mid-run micromanagement of card drafts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or integradet Grafik (Intel UHD 630)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
